lines.text: Shechem, son of Hamor the Hivite, takes Dinah by force, then asks his father to get her as a wife.
Jacob stays silent until his sons return from the field, and they are filled with grief and fury.
Jacob's sons deceitfully say they will agree only if every male among them is circumcised like them.
Three days after the circumcision, Reuben and Levi slaughter every male in the city and take Dinah from Shechem's house.
Jacob says the people of the land may unite and attack, but his sons ask if their sister should be treated like a prostitute.
